name: Dexter James D. Benitez
program: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
headline: Computer Science student & aspiring AI Engineer
short_bio: I’m Dexter, a 21-year-old Computer Science student at CIT-University. I enjoy building useful projects and exploring how AI can help people. My goal is to become an AI Engineer.

autobiography.background: I am 21 years old and currently live in Tisa, Cebu. My hometown is Hinatuan, Surigao del Sur. I chose Computer Science because I enjoy innovation and building things that can be useful to other people and to me. My brother, who also studied Computer Science, helped inspire my decision by sharing the career opportunities in the field.
autobiography.education: I am a third-year Bachelor of Science in Computer Science student at CIT-University, in section F1. My studies have challenged me to keep improving, especially in demanding subjects such as DAA and DSA. Passing those subjects has been a meaningful achievement for me. As I continue learning and building projects, I am working toward my goal of becoming an AI Engineer.
autobiography.interests: Outside my studies, I enjoy gaming, especially Mobile Legends, and listening to music. I also like working out at the gym and staying fit. In my spare time, I enjoy making fun side projects and trying out ideas that I find useful or interesting.

projects.title: CITUClinicSystem
projects.description: A university clinic management system with separate student, provider, and administrator workflows.
projects.outcome: The source includes appointment management, provider schedules, patient medical records, support tickets, audit logs, and PDF medical-history export.

projects.title: tinHealth
projects.description: A Java/JavaFX desktop health tracker for daily meals, physical activities, and reminders to move during computer use.
projects.role: Backend development, database operations, and some frontend work (team project)
projects.outcome: The team application includes meal and activity logging, nutritional data integration, user preferences, and a repository/data-source layer for database operations. Its README credits my backend and database contributions.

projects.title: Parola
projects.description: A team AI project for municipal fisherfolk that combines ocean and fisheries data to identify potential fishing zones and support advisories through a web portal and SMS.
projects.outcome: The repository contains pelagic and demersal LightGBM notebooks, ocean-data processing, habitat-suitability calculations, mapping, and SMS-advisory integration.
